system_configurations.name: RCCL-SocketPollTimeout
system_configurations.description: Tests for NCCL_SOCKET_POLL_TIMEOUT_MSEC (NCCL v2.29.2-1). Expected to fail on develop until the upstream socketWait poll() change is sync'd into RCCL.

tests.name: SocketPollTimeout_ParamParsing
tests.description: ZOMBIES coverage of NCCL_SOCKET_POLL_TIMEOUT_MSEC parsing in ncclParamPollTimeOut().

tests.name: SocketPollTimeout_Behaviour
tests.description: Loopback socket pair tests asserting that socketWait spins when the param is unset and parks (low CPU) when it is non-zero, plus a correctness check.

tests.name: SocketPollTimeout_CpuUsage
tests.description: End-to-end CPU usage assertion: drives sendrecv_perf twice (poll unset vs =10) and fails if the poll run does not reduce child CPU time meaningfully. Slow / GPU + MPI required.
